local View = {}

local function font(family, weight)
	return Font.new(family, weight, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
end

local COLORS = {
	bgTop = Color3.fromRGB(7, 18, 38),
	bgBottom = Color3.fromRGB(3, 10, 20),
	cyan = Color3.fromRGB(51, 207, 255),
	cobalt = Color3.fromRGB(45, 91, 255),
	navy = Color3.fromRGB(10, 34, 66),
	gold = Color3.fromRGB(243, 200, 106),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255),
	textSecondary = Color3.fromRGB(184, 210, 232),
	row = Color3.fromRGB(18, 49, 84),
	rowDark = Color3.fromRGB(11, 28, 53),
	shadow = Color3.fromRGB(3, 10, 20),
	success = Color3.fromRGB(89, 217, 165),
	danger = Color3.fromRGB(255, 107, 122),
}

local function createUIShadow(parent, transparency, blur, yOffset)
	local ok, shadow = pcall(Instance.new, "UIShadow")
	if ok and shadow then
		shadow.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		shadow.Transparency = transparency or 0.72
		shadow.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, blur or 16)
		shadow.Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(0, yOffset or 5)
		shadow.Parent = parent
		return shadow
	end
	return nil
end

local function addTextStroke(label, transparency)
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Name = "TextBacking"
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
	stroke.Color = COLORS.navy
	stroke.Thickness = 1.5
	stroke.Transparency = transparency or 0.55
	stroke.Parent = label
	return stroke
end

local function styleLabel(label, role)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextColor3 = role == "secondary" and COLORS.textSecondary or COLORS.text
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.RichText = false
	label.TextWrapped = role == "body"
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	if role == "display" then
		label.FontFace = font("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold)
		label.TextSize = 44
	elseif role == "heading" then
		label.FontFace = font("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
		label.TextSize = 24
	elseif role == "button" then
		label.FontFace = font("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold)
		label.TextSize = 22
	else
		label.FontFace = font("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
		label.TextSize = 18
	end
	local constraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
	constraint.MinTextSize = role == "caption" and 12 or 14
	constraint.MaxTextSize = role == "display" and 44 or (role == "heading" and 24 or (role == "button" and 22 or 18))
	constraint.Parent = label
	addTextStroke(label, role == "display" and 0.7 or 0.8)
	return label
end

local function makeImageSliceButton(name, image, sliceCenter, sliceScale)
	local button = Instance.new("ImageButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.Image = image
	button.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	button.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	button.SliceCenter = Rect.new(sliceCenter[1], sliceCenter[2], sliceCenter[3], sliceCenter[4])
	button.SliceScale = sliceScale
	return button
end

local function makeImageSliceLabel(name, image, sliceCenter, sliceScale)
	local label = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Image = image
	label.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	label.SliceCenter = Rect.new(sliceCenter[1], sliceCenter[2], sliceCenter[3], sliceCenter[4])
	label.SliceScale = sliceScale
	return label
end

local function makeIcon(name, image)
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Name = name
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = image
	icon.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	icon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	return icon
end

local function makeButtonContents(button, title, iconImage, iconSize)
	local visual = Instance.new("Frame")
	visual.Name = "Visual"
	visual.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	visual.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	visual.Parent = button

	local gloss = Instance.new("Frame")
	gloss.Name = "Gloss"
	gloss.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.78
	gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
	gloss.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	gloss.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.08)
	gloss.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.2)
	gloss.Parent = visual
	local glossCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	glossCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	glossCorner.Parent = gloss
	local glossGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	glossGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.9),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.15),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.9),
	})
	glossGradient.Rotation = 0
	glossGradient.Parent = gloss

	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	content.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	content.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.72)
	content.Parent = visual

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 12)
	layout.Parent = content

	local icon = makeIcon(button.Name .. "Icon", iconImage)
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize, iconSize)
	icon.LayoutOrder = 1
	icon.Parent = content

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Label"
	label.Text = title
	label.LayoutOrder = 2
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.65, 1)
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	styleLabel(label, "button")
	label.Parent = content

	return visual
end

local function createCornerOrnament(parent, name, anchorX, anchorY, posX, posY, flipX, flipY, size)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = name
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(anchorX, anchorY)
	holder.Position = UDim2.new(posX, 0, posY, 0)
	holder.Size = size
	holder.Parent = parent

	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Scale = 1
	scale.Parent = holder

	local lineA = Instance.new("Frame")
	lineA.Name = "LineA"
	lineA.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.gold
	lineA.BorderSizePixel = 0
	lineA.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	lineA.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.34, 0.16)
	lineA.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.52, 0.07)
	lineA.Rotation = flipX and -22 or 22
	lineA.Parent = holder
	local c1 = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c1.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	c1.Parent = lineA

	local lineB = Instance.new("Frame")
	lineB.Name = "LineB"
	lineB.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.cyan
	lineB.BorderSizePixel = 0
	lineB.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	lineB.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.18, 0.34)
	lineB.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.06)
	lineB.Rotation = flipY and -68 or 68
	lineB.Parent = holder
	local c2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	c2.Parent = lineB

	local jewel = Instance.new("Frame")
	jewel.Name = "Jewel"
	jewel.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.cobalt
	jewel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	jewel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	jewel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.1)
	jewel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.16, 0.16)
	jewel.Parent = holder
	local c3 = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c3.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.3, 0)
	c3.Parent = jewel
	local s3 = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s3.Color = COLORS.navy
	s3.Thickness = 3
	s3.Parent = jewel
	local g3 = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g3.Color = ColorSequence.new(COLORS.cyan, COLORS.cobalt)
	g3.Rotation = 45
	g3.Parent = jewel

	holder.Rotation = (flipX and 180 or 0) + (flipY and 180 or 0)
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	return holder
end

	rightBloom.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.28, 0.36)

	local rbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	rbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	rbCorner.Parent = rightBloom

	local vignetteTop = Instance.new("Frame")
	vignetteTop.Name = "VignetteTop"
	vignetteTop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	vignetteTop.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
	vignetteTop.BorderSizePixel = 0
	vignetteTop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.18, 0)
	vignetteTop.Parent = backgroundLayer
	local vtGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	vtGradient.Rotation = 90
	vtGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	vtGradient.Parent = vignetteTop

	local vignetteBottom = Instance.new("Frame")
	vignetteBottom.Name = "VignetteBottom"
	vignetteBottom.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	vignetteBottom.BackgroundTransparency = 0.78
	vignetteBottom.BorderSizePixel = 0
	vignetteBottom.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	vignetteBottom.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	vignetteBottom.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.26, 0)
	vignetteBottom.Parent = backgroundLayer
	local vbGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	vbGradient.Rotation = 270
	vbGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	vbGradient.Parent = vignetteBottom

	local ornaments = Instance.new("Frame")
	ornaments.Name = "BackgroundOrnaments"
	ornaments.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ornaments.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	ornaments.Parent = parent

	createCornerOrnament(ornaments, "TopLeft", 0, 0, 0.045, 0.055, false, false, mobile and UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64) or UDim2.fromOffset(88, 88))
	createCornerOrnament(ornaments, "TopRight", 1, 0, 0.955, 0.055, true, false, mobile and UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64) or UDim2.fromOffset(88, 88))
	createCornerOrnament(ornaments, "BottomLeft", 0, 1, 0.045, 0.945, false, true, mobile and UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64) or UDim2.fromOffset(88, 88))
	createCornerOrnament(ornaments, "BottomRight", 1, 1, 0.955, 0.945, true, true, mobile and UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64) or UDim2.fromOffset(88, 88))

local function createMainButton(parent, name, text, skinUri, iconUri, sliceCenter, mobile, heightScale)
	local button = makeImageSliceButton(name, skinUri, sliceCenter, 0.2)
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, mobile and math.floor(80 * heightScale) or math.floor(92 * heightScale))
	button.LayoutOrder = name == "PlayButton" and 2 or (name == "SettingsButton" and 3 or 4)
	button.Parent = parent
	local shadow = createUIShadow(button, 0.8, name == "PlayButton" and 20 or 14, name == "PlayButton" and 8 or 5)
	makeButtonContents(button, text, iconUri, mobile and 26 or 28)

	local hitPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	hitPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 0)
	hitPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 0)
	hitPadding.Parent = button

	local innerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	innerStroke.Name = "AccentStroke"
	innerStroke.Color = COLORS.gold
	innerStroke.Thickness = 1
	innerStroke.Transparency = 0.55
	innerStroke.Parent = button

	return button, shadow
end

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local root = script.Parent
local source = root:WaitForChild("_NexusSource")
local Responsive = require(source.Runtime.Responsive)
local ButtonEffects = require(source.Runtime.ButtonEffects)

local cleanupResponsive = Responsive.bind(root)
local bindings = {}

local function track(binding)
	if binding then
		table.insert(bindings, binding)
	end
	return binding
end

local function destroyBindings()
	for _, binding in ipairs(bindings) do
		if binding and binding.Destroy then
			binding:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(bindings)
end

local function getVariants()
	local variants = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and (child.Name == "_NexusDesktop" or child.Name == "_NexusMobile") then
			table.insert(variants, child)
		end
	end
	return variants
end

local function iterNamed(name)
	local results = {}
	for _, variant in ipairs(getVariants()) do
		for _, node in ipairs(variant:GetDescendants()) do
			if node.Name == name then
				table.insert(results, node)
			end
		end
	end
	return results
end

local function tween(object, info, goal)
	local t = TweenService:Create(object, info, goal)
	t:Play()
	return t
end

local activeModalName = nil
local activeModalHost = nil
local isMenuClosed = false
local defaultMusicOn = true
local defaultVolume = 0.7

local function findVisibleVariant()
	for _, variant in ipairs(getVariants()) do
		if variant.Visible then
			return variant
		end
	end
	return getVariants()[1]
end

local function getVisibleMenuDock()
	local variant = findVisibleVariant()

end

local function getVisibleModalHost(hostName)
	local variant = findVisibleVariant()

end

local function ensureCanvasGroup(node)
	if node:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
		return node
	end
	local parent = node.Parent
	local replacement = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	replacement.Name = node.Name
	replacement.AnchorPoint = node.AnchorPoint
	replacement.AutomaticSize = node.AutomaticSize
	replacement.BackgroundColor3 = node.BackgroundColor3
	replacement.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	replacement.BorderColor3 = node.BorderColor3
	replacement.BorderMode = node.BorderMode
	replacement.BorderSizePixel = node.BorderSizePixel
	replacement.ClipsDescendants = node.ClipsDescendants
	replacement.GroupColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	replacement.GroupTransparency = 0
	replacement.LayoutOrder = node.LayoutOrder
	replacement.Position = node.Position
	replacement.Rotation = node.Rotation
	replacement.Selectable = node.Selectable
	replacement.SelectionOrder = node.SelectionOrder
	replacement.Size = node.Size
	replacement.SizeConstraint = node.SizeConstraint
	replacement.Visible = node.Visible
	replacement.ZIndex = node.ZIndex
	for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
		child.Parent = replacement
	end
	replacement.Parent = parent
	node:Destroy()
	return replacement
end

for _, dock in ipairs(iterNamed("MainMenuDock")) do

end

local function animateModal(host, opening)
	if not host then
		return
	end
	local modal = host:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel", true)
	local dismiss = host:FindFirstChild("Dismiss")
	local modalScale = modal and modal:FindFirstChild("ModalScale")
	if opening then
		host.Visible = true
		if dismiss then
			dismiss.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			tween(dismiss, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.38,
			})
		end
		if modal then
			modal.ImageTransparency = 1
			tween(modal, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				ImageTransparency = 0,
			})
		end
		if modalScale then
			modalScale.Scale = 0.96
			tween(modalScale, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Scale = 1,
			})
		end
	else
		if dismiss then
			tween(dismiss, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			})
		end
		if modal then
			tween(modal, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				ImageTransparency = 1,
			})
		end
		if modalScale then
			tween(modalScale, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				Scale = 0.98,
			})
		end
		task.delay(0.13, function()
			if host.Parent then
				host.Visible = false
				if modal then
					modal.ImageTransparency = 0
				end
				if dismiss then
					dismiss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.38
				end
				if modalScale then
					modalScale.Scale = 1
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function closeActiveModal()
	if activeModalHost then
		animateModal(activeModalHost, false)
	end
	activeModalName = nil
	activeModalHost = nil
	setMenuDimmed(false)
end

local function openModal(hostName)
	if isMenuClosed then
		return
	end
	local host = getVisibleModalHost(hostName)
	if not host then
		return
	end
	if activeModalHost == host then
		return
	end
	if activeModalHost then
		animateModal(activeModalHost, false)
	end
	activeModalName = hostName
	activeModalHost = host
	setMenuDimmed(true)
	animateModal(host, true)
end

local function closeMenuAndFireHook()
	if isMenuClosed then
		return
	end
	isMenuClosed = true
	closeActiveModal()

	for _, variant in ipairs(getVariants()) do
		variant.Active = false
		local dock = variant:FindFirstChild("MainMenuDock", true)
		if dock then
			tween(dock, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				GroupTransparency = 1,
				Position = dock.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16),
			})
		end
	end

	task.delay(0.2, function()
		for _, variant in ipairs(getVariants()) do
			variant.Visible = false
		end
		root.Enabled = false
		local variant = findVisibleVariant()
		local hook
		if variant then
			hook = variant:FindFirstChild("OnPlayRequestedHook", true)
		end
		if not hook then
			for _, candidate in ipairs(iterNamed("OnPlayRequestedHook")) do
				hook = candidate
				break
			end
		end
		if hook and hook:IsA("BindableEvent") then
			hook:Fire()
		end
	end)
end

local function setToggleState(toggle, isOn, instant)
	local housing = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	local activeFill = housing and housing:FindFirstChild("ActiveFill")
	local thumb = housing and housing:FindFirstChild("Thumb")
	local stateLabel = toggle:FindFirstChild("StateLabel")
	if not (housing and activeFill and thumb and stateLabel) then
		return
	end

	local targetXScale = isOn and 1 or 0
	local xOffset = isOn and (toggle.AbsoluteSize.X - thumb.AbsoluteSize.X - 4) or 4
	local targetPos = UDim2.new(0, xOffset, 0.5, 0)

	stateLabel.Text = isOn and "ON" or "OFF"
	stateLabel.TextColor3 = isOn and Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(184, 210, 232)

	if instant or GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
		activeFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(targetXScale, 1)
		thumb.Position = targetPos
	else
		tween(activeFill, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(targetXScale, 1),
		})
		tween(thumb, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = targetPos,
		})
	end
end

local function setSliderValue(slider, value, instant)
	value = math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
	local track = slider:FindFirstChild("Track")
	local fill = track and track:FindFirstChild("Fill")
	local handle = slider:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	local row = slider.Parent and slider.Parent.Parent
	local valueLabel = row and row.Parent and row.Parent:FindFirstChild("VolumeValue")
	if not (track and fill and handle) then
		return
	end

	local targetFill = UDim2.fromScale(value, 1)
	local x = math.floor(track.AbsoluteSize.X * value + 0.5)
	local targetHandle = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.5, 0)

	if valueLabel and valueLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
		valueLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
	end

	if instant or GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
		fill.Size = targetFill
		handle.Position = targetHandle
	else
		tween(fill, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = targetFill,
		})
		tween(handle, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = targetHandle,
		})
	end
end

	end

	for _, closeButton in ipairs(iterNamed("SettingsCloseButton")) do
		track(ButtonEffects.bind(closeButton, {
			visual = closeButton:FindFirstChild("Visual") or closeButton,
			hoverScale = 1.03,
			pressScale = 0.95,
			duration = 0.1,
			sounds = false,
		}))
		closeButton.Activated:Connect(closeActiveModal)
	end

	for _, closeButton in ipairs(iterNamed("CreditsCloseButton")) do
		track(ButtonEffects.bind(closeButton, {
			visual = closeButton:FindFirstChild("Visual") or closeButton,
			hoverScale = 1.03,
			pressScale = 0.95,
			duration = 0.1,
			sounds = false,
		}))
		closeButton.Activated:Connect(closeActiveModal)
	end

	for _, dismiss in ipairs(iterNamed("Dismiss")) do
		if dismiss:IsA("GuiButton") then
			dismiss.Activated:Connect(closeActiveModal)
		end
	end

	for _, toggle in ipairs(iterNamed("MusicToggle")) do
		track(ButtonEffects.bind(toggle, {
			visual = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual") or toggle,
			hoverScale = 1.02,
			pressScale = 0.98,
			duration = 0.1,
			sounds = false,
		}))
		setToggleState(toggle, defaultMusicOn, true)
		toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
			defaultMusicOn = not defaultMusicOn
			for _, syncToggle in ipairs(iterNamed("MusicToggle")) do
				setToggleState(syncToggle, defaultMusicOn, false)
			end
		end)
	end

	local dragging = false
	local dragSlider = nil

	local function updateDrag(input)
		if not dragging or not dragSlider then
			return
		end
		local track = dragSlider:FindFirstChild("Track")
		if not track then
			return
		end
		local alpha = 0
		if track.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
			alpha = (input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X
		end
		defaultVolume = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
		for _, syncSlider in ipairs(iterNamed("VolumeSlider")) do
			setSliderValue(syncSlider, defaultVolume, false)
		end
	end

	for _, slider in ipairs(iterNamed("VolumeSlider")) do
		setSliderValue(slider, defaultVolume, true)
		local dragHit = slider:FindFirstChild("DragHitTarget")
		if dragHit and dragHit:IsA("GuiButton") then
			track(ButtonEffects.bind(dragHit, {
				visual = slider,
				hoverScale = 1.0,
				pressScale = 1.0,
				duration = 0.08,
				sounds = false,
			}))
			dragHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					dragging = true
					dragSlider = slider
					updateDrag(input)
				end
			end)
			dragHit.Activated:Connect(function()
				local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
				updateDrag({
					Position = Vector3.new(mousePos.X, mousePos.Y, 0),
				})
			end)
		end
	end

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			updateDrag(input)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
			dragSlider = nil
		end
	end)
end

bindButtons()

root.Destroying:Connect(function()
	destroyBindings()
	if cleanupResponsive then
		cleanupResponsive()
	end
end)

local Responsive = {}
function Responsive.bind(root)
    local cameraConnection
    local connections = {}
    local function update()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        local mobile = math.min(size.X, size.Y) < 600
        for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if node.Name == "_NexusDesktop" then node.Visible = not mobile end
                if node.Name == "_NexusMobile" then node.Visible = mobile end
            end
        end
    end
    local function observeCamera()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then cameraConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update) end
        update()
    end
    table.insert(connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(observeCamera))
    local function cleanup()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    table.insert(connections, root.Destroying:Connect(cleanup))
    observeCamera()
    return cleanup
end
return Responsive

-- Original reference implementation from 06-ui-motion-and-interaction.md
-- Reviewed 2026-09-11. Not Roblox Studio runtime-verified.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ButtonFeedback = {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastSoundAt = { hover = -math.huge, click = -math.huge }

-- Backward compatible: bind(button, childVisual) or bind(button, options).
-- Prefer options.visual = the stable button's child Visual frame.
function ButtonFeedback.bind(button, visualOrOptions, options)
    local visual
    if typeof(visualOrOptions) == "Instance" then
        visual = visualOrOptions
        options = options or {}
    else
        options = visualOrOptions or {}
        visual = options.visual or button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
    end
    assert(button:IsA("GuiButton"), "expected a GuiButton")
    assert(visual:IsA("GuiObject") and (visual == button or visual:IsDescendantOf(button)),
        "visual must be a child visual inside the button")
    assert(not bound[button], "button already has a feedback binding")
    assert(not visual:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"),
        "visual UIScale already has an owner")
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Name = "FeedbackScale"
    scale.Parent = visual
    local alive, focused = true, GuiService.SelectedObject == button
    local currentTween = nil
    local shadowTween = nil
    local connections = {}
    local sounds = {}
    local originalAutoColor = button.AutoButtonColor
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local controller = {}
    bound[button] = controller
    local previousState = nil
    local hoverScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.hoverScale) or 1.05, 1, 1.1)
    local pressScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.pressScale) or 0.95, 0.85, 1)
    local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(options.duration) or 0.12, 0.06, 0.3)
    local shadow = options.shadow
    local shadowPosition = shadow and shadow.Position

    local function soundFor(kind, soundId)
        if type(soundId) ~= "string" or not soundId:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then return end
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "Feedback_" .. kind
        sound.SoundId = soundId
        sound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(options.volume) or 0.18, 0, 0.35)
        sound.Parent = button
        sounds[kind] = sound
    end
    soundFor("hover", options.hoverSound)
    soundFor("click", options.clickSound)

    local function playSound(kind)
        if not alive or not button.Interactable or options.sounds == false then return end
        local sound = sounds[kind]
        local now = os.clock()
        local delay = kind == "hover" and 0.12 or 0.08
        if not sound or now - lastSoundAt[kind] < delay then return end
        lastSoundAt[kind] = now
        sound.TimePosition = 0
        sound:Play()
    end

    local function pointerAvailable()
        return UserInputService.MouseEnabled
            and UserInputService:GetLastInputType() ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    local function refresh()
        if not alive then return end
        local state = button.GuiState
        local target = 1
        if button.Interactable then
            if state == Enum.GuiState.Press then
                target = pressScale
            elseif (state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false) or focused then
                target = hoverScale
            end
        end
        if state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and previousState ~= state and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false then
            playSound("hover")
        end
        previousState = state
        if currentTween then
            currentTween:Cancel()
            currentTween = nil
        end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled or options.animations == false then
            scale.Scale = 1
            if shadow then shadow.Position = shadowPosition end
            return
        end
        currentTween = TweenService:Create(scale,
            TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = target })
        currentTween:Play()
        if shadow then
            local offset = state == Enum.GuiState.Press and -2 or 0
            shadowTween = TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(duration),
                { Position = shadowPosition + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset) })
            shadowTween:Play()
        end
    end

    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("Interactable"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
        focused = true
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
        focused = false
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = GuiService
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("ReducedMotionEnabled"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
        playSound("click")
    end)

    function controller:Destroy()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel() end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _, sound in pairs(sounds) do sound:Destroy() end
        bound[button] = nil
        scale:Destroy()
        pcall(function() button.AutoButtonColor = originalAutoColor end)
        if shadow then pcall(function() shadow.Position = shadowPosition end) end
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Destroying:Connect(function()
        controller:Destroy()
    end)
    refresh()
    return controller
end

return ButtonFeedback
